hero.title: Do the best work of your career on problems that matter
hero.subtitle: We are a founding team hiring our first colleagues. Join people with decades in the field, at the moment everything is still being shaped — and shape it with us.

benefits.title: Work on the frontier
benefits.body: Ship production AI and agentic systems most engineers only read about — with the guardrails to do it responsibly.

benefits.title: Practitioners lead
benefits.body: Your managers still write code, run models and sit with clients. Career paths reward craft, not just headcount.

benefits.title: Flexible by design
benefits.body: Remote-first with hubs in San Francisco, New York and London. Async-friendly, meeting-light.

benefits.title: Invest in you
benefits.body: Annual learning budget, conference time, and 10% time for research and open source.

benefits.title: Own the upside
benefits.body: Founding-stage equity for every early hire — join now and own a real piece of what we build.

benefits.title: Health, fully covered
benefits.body: Comprehensive medical, dental and vision for you and your dependents, plus generous parental leave.

hiringProcess.title: Intro conversation
hiringProcess.body: Thirty minutes with the hiring lead about your work, your goals and whether the role fits. No trick questions.

hiringProcess.title: Craft session
hiringProcess.body: A working session in your discipline — real problems from our practice, done together, not on a whiteboard from memory.

hiringProcess.title: Team round
hiringProcess.body: Meet the people you would work with, including someone outside your discipline. You interview us as much as we interview you.

hiringProcess.title: Offer & onboarding
hiringProcess.body: A clear offer with compensation transparency, and a first-quarter plan that puts you on real client work with a dedicated buddy.
